If politics comes up, politely redirecting: "I'd rather not get into that tonight"
Finding common ground on non-political topics (family updates, food, shared interests)
Remembering that your mother-in-law is still family, and relationships matter more than winning political arguments
If you genuinely want to have political conversations:
Wait for a private moment when everyone's calmer
Listen to understand her perspective, not just to counter it
Focus on specific policies rather than name-calling or broad insults about groups
Accept that you may not change each other's minds—and that's okay
